```{r missings, results = "asis", out.width = "100%"}
############missings at t1
dep_vars <- map_chr(models, ~ all.vars(formula(.x))[1])

# Filtered data once (visit == "t1")
data_t1 <- NeuroMET %>% filter(visit == "t1")

# For each model/dependent variable, count missing in that var by diagnose_group
missingt1_table <- map2_df(
  names(models), dep_vars,
  ~ data_t1 %>%
    group_by(diagnose_group) %>%
    summarise(missing = sum(is.na(.data[[.y]])), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(model = .x)
)

# Convert to wide format: rows = models, columns = diagnose_group, values = missing counts
missingt1_wide <- missingt1_table %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diagnose_group, values_from = missing) %>%
  select(model, everything()) %>%
  arrange(match(model, names(models)))

#missingt1_wide
# One participant in the CN Aβ+ group had missing MRS data at visit 1 but was included in the analysis because MRS was available at a follow-up visit.

############missings at follow-ups
dep_vars <- map_chr(models, ~ all.vars(formula(.x))[1])

# Filtered data once (visit == "t1")
data_followup <- NeuroMET %>% filter(!(visit == "t1"))

# For each model/dependent variable, count missing in that var by diagnose_group
missing_followup_table <- map2_df(
  names(models), dep_vars,
  ~ data_followup %>%
    group_by(diagnose_group) %>%
    summarise(missing = sum(is.na(.data[[.y]])), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(model = .x)
)

# Convert to wide format: rows = models, columns = diagnose_group, values = missing counts
missing_followup_wide <- missing_followup_table %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diagnose_group, values_from = missing) %>%
  select(model, everything()) %>%
  arrange(match(model, names(models)))

##### table 
# Adjust "MRS_Glu" to the actual variable you're using for MRS data
# Count available participants
table_n <- NeuroMET %>%
  group_by(diagnose_group, visit) %>%
  tally() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diagnose_group, values_from = n)

# Calculate mean (SD) time from baseline
table_time <- NeuroMET %>%
  group_by(diagnose_group, visit) %>%
  summarize(`time from V1 [years]` = paste0(round(mean(year, na.rm = TRUE), 1), 
                                            " (", round(sd(year, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diagnose_group, values_from = `time from V1 [years]`)

# Count missing MRS data
table_miss <- NeuroMET %>%
  group_by(diagnose_group, visit) %>%
  summarize(`n missing MRS` = sum(is.na(glu)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diagnose_group, values_from = `n missing MRS`)

# Ensure all values are character before binding rows
table_n <- table_n %>% mutate(across(-visit, as.character))
table_time <- table_time %>% mutate(across(-visit, as.character))
table_miss <- table_miss %>% mutate(across(-visit, as.character))
# Combine all parts
table_combined <- bind_rows(
  mutate(table_n, rowname = "n"),
  mutate(table_time, rowname = "time from V1 [years]"),
  mutate(table_miss, rowname = "n missing MRS")
) %>%
  arrange(visit, factor(rowname, levels = c("n", "n missing MRS", "time from V1 [years]"))) %>%
  select(rowname, everything(), -visit)

# Print with row grouping per visit
Table_2 <- table_combined %>%
  kbl(
    caption = "<b>Table 2: Observations grouped by diagnosis and visit. </b> Time from visit 1 is presented as mean (SD). The rows “n missing MRS” indicate how many participants had no MRS data at the respective visit. Further statistical models might contain fewer observations according to data availability. <i>Abbreviations: AD = Alzheimer’s Disease, CN = Cognitively Normal, MCI = Mild Cognitive Impairment, MRS = Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, V1 = Visit 1 </i>",
    align = "c"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows("Visit 1", 1, 3) %>%
  pack_rows("Visit 2", 4, 6) %>%
  pack_rows("Visit 3", 7, 9) %>%
  pack_rows("Visit 4", 10, 12) %>%
  pack_rows("Visit 5", 13, 15)
```
